title: Pulse-Client request header
description: Since 2.1. Optional header a client sends on every request to say what it is and which protocol majors it speaks (PROTOCOL.md §7), e.g. `Pulse/2.1.0 (45; ios); protocol=1-2`. A server answers 426 Upgrade Required on uploads and artifacts when the client's newest protocol is older than its oldest. Without the header, nothing changes.
